title: client.gleam demo branches discard the mutated DemoStore (`let _ = next`) at all four call sites — create/edit/mark-opened mutations never reach the model
detail: demo_api mutation functions return #(DemoStore, Effect) but every client.gleam demo branch drops the store. Created vacancy never enters the store → handoff/detail refetch from the store fails (error page); edits silently no-op; auto-open Submitted→UnderReview reverts on refetch.
recommended_fix: Thread `next` into the returned model (`Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next))`) at all four call sites, as demo_update.gleam already does.

title: demo_api.download builds the request from a relative URI — request.from_uri requires a host, so the demo report download always returns internal_error
evidence:
let url = "/static/demo/report-" <> application_id <> ".pdf"
  use dispatch <- effect.from
  case request.from_uri(uri_from(url)) {
    Error(_) -> dispatch(on_response(Error(internal_error())))

and gleam_http/src/gleam/http/request.gleam:44:
pub fn from_uri(uri: Uri) -> Result(Request(String), Nil) {
  use scheme <- result.try(...)
  use host <- result.try(
    uri.host
    |> option.to_result(Nil),
  )
detail: uri.parse on "/static/demo/..." yields host None; from_uri then returns Error(Nil) unconditionally, so download always dispatches Error(internal_error()) before any fetch — the mock report download (acceptance checklist item) can never succeed.
recommended_fix: Build the request without from_uri (e.g. request.new() |> request.set_path(url) as other client fetch call sites do), or use rsvp with the relative URL.

title: analysis_id→application_id mapping drops 3 chars: "an-aoife" becomes "aoife", but the baked PDFs and filename table are keyed "a-aoife"
evidence:
let application_id = string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3)
  let filename = case
    list.find(demo_store.report_filenames(), fn(p) { p.0 == application_id })

report_filenames() keys: #("a-aoife", "RightTenantry-Report-Aoife-Ni-Riain.pdf"); server/priv/static/demo/ contains report-a-aoife.pdf; analysis ids seeded as analysis("an-aoife", app_id, ...) and the view passes analysis.id
detail: drop_start("an-aoife", 3) = "aoife" — the filename lookup misses (falls to generic name) and the URL "/static/demo/report-aoife.pdf" does not exist (real file is report-a-aoife.pdf), so even with a well-formed request the fetch 404s.
recommended_fix: Replace the prefix instead of dropping it: "a-" <> string.drop_start(analysis_id, 2), or map analysis id → application id via the store.

title: refetch_refcheck_effect has no demo branch — every demo refcheck action (skip/re-enable/start/take-over/correct) fires a real application_api fetch afterwards
detail: After any demo reference-check action the response handler issues a real GET /api/v1/... for v-maples/a-tom with no session — unauthenticated 401, network call from demo mode (the CI lint only greps client/src/demo/), and the error arm flips the detail page to Failure.
recommended_fix: Add a demo_mode branch in refetch_refcheck_effect calling demo_api.fetch_application_detail(demo_store_of(model), ...), mirroring the branch in handle_application_opened.

title: Bulk-reject request messages are not intercepted by demo_update — UserClickedMarkAllRejected / UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected fall through to real arms firing a real POST from demo mode
evidence:
UserClickedMarkAllRejected(vid) ->
      ...
              application_api.bulk_reject_applications(
                vid,
                ids,
                "sweep_nudge",
                model.csrf_token,
                ApiReturnedBulkReject,
              )
    UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected(vid) -> ... application_api.bulk_reject_applications(...)

(grep of client/src/demo/demo_update.gleam for "BulkReject" finds no arm; `_ -> fallback(model, msg)` routes both to update_inner; demo_api.bulk_reject_applications exists but is never called)
detail: In demo, leaderboard select-mode reject and the sweep-nudge reject-all send a real authenticated-intent POST to the live API (csrf "demo-csrf-token", no session → 401 error toast). A write attempt to a real endpoint from demo mode; the demo_store bulk_reject is dead code.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserClickedMarkAllRejected / UserClickedMarkSelectedRejected in demo_update.handle and route them through demo_api.bulk_reject_applications.

title: ApiReturnedRestoreVacancy Ok refetches the archived list via the real vacancy_api with no demo branch — demo restore ends in a 401 and a Failure archived page
evidence:
ApiReturnedRestoreVacancy(result) ->
      case result {
        Ok(_) -> #(
          Model(
            ..model,
            archived_vacancies: Loading,
            vacancies: NotAsked,
            dashboard_stats: NotAsked,
            loading_action: None,
          ),
          vacancy_api.fetch_archived(ApiReturnedArchivedVacancies),
        )
detail: demo_update intercepts UserClickedRestoreVacancy and dispatches ApiReturnedRestoreVacancy(Ok), whose handler fires a real fetch_archived (no session → 401) → ApiReturnedArchivedVacancies(Error) renders the archived page as Failure. Network call from demo + broken restore flow (an acceptance-checklist flow).
recommended_fix: Branch on model.demo_mode in the ApiReturnedRestoreVacancy Ok arm and use demo_api.fetch_archived(demo_store_of(model), ...).

title: UserToggledNotificationDropdown opens fire a real notification_api.fetch_notifications in demo mode
detail: demo_update intercepts AppRequestedNotifications but not UserToggledNotificationDropdown, so opening the bell in demo issues a real unauthenticated GET → ApiReturnedNotifications(Error) → bell shows "Couldn't load notifications" despite the store holding seeded notifications.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserToggledNotificationDropdown in demo_update (serve demo_api.fetch_notifications from the store) or add a demo branch in the real arm.

title: Demo UserConfirmedApproval builds the leaderboard refetch from the pre-mutation store — approved applicant's leaderboard status stays stale
detail: store_of(model) reads the old store; demo_api.fetch_leaderboard resolves entries eagerly from it, so the delivered leaderboard predates the approval. Demo polling is a no-op (AppPolledData → none), so the stale leaderboard persists until the next navigation. Rejection/backward arms have no leaderboard refetch at all.
recommended_fix: Use store_of(updated) (the post-mutation store) for leaderboard_eff.

title: reset_demo on a detail/archived/comparison route leaves the page on a permanent loading spinner — NotAsked with no refetch and no route change
evidence:
Model(
          ..model,
          demo_store: Some(store),
          ...
          vacancy_detail: NotAsked,
          leaderboard: NotAsked,
          application_detail: NotAsked,
          comparison_details: NotAsked,
          archived_vacancies: NotAsked,
          ...
        ),
        demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications),

(and pages/vacancy_detail.gleam:26 `NotAsked | Loading -> view_loading()`, pages/application_detail.gleam:40 same; the banner reset button renders on every demo page via components/shell.gleam)
detail: Reset re-seeds but keeps the current route and only refetches notifications; the detail/archived/comparison data is set to NotAsked and nothing re-requests it (demo polling is disabled), so those pages render view_loading forever after a reset.
recommended_fix: On reset, either navigate to the dashboard (modem.push("/dashboard")) or re-fire the current route's demo fetches (reuse demo_entry_effects(store, model.route)).

title: Demo refcheck actions use snake_case action names ("re_enable", "take_over") but the response handler's toast matches kebab-case — wrong toast copy shown
evidence:
RefcheckReEnable -> fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "re_enable")
            RefcheckConfirmTakeOver ->
              fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "take_over")

client/src/client.gleam:3079:
                "re-enable" -> copy.refcheck_toast_re_enabled
                "take-over" -> copy.refcheck_toast_taken_over
                "correct" -> copy.refcheck_toast_corrected
                _ -> copy.refcheck_toast_substituted
detail: "re_enable" and "take_over" fall through to `_ -> copy.refcheck_toast_substituted`, so re-enabling or taking over a reference in demo shows the 'substituted' success toast instead of the matching copy.
recommended_fix: Pass the same action strings the handler matches ("re-enable", "take-over") and map them in demo_store.apply_refcheck, or extend the toast case.

title: Demo UserClickedNotification arm never closes the notification dropdown (real arm sets show_notification_dropdown: False)
detail: Clicking a notification in demo marks it read but the dropdown stays open (the real handler closes it). ApiReturnedMarkRead does not close it either, so it remains open until manually toggled.
recommended_fix: Add show_notification_dropdown: False to the demo arm's model update.

title: id_suffix is deterministic on property name — creating two demo vacancies with the same name yields colliding ids, and id-keyed mutations then hit both
detail: Two vacancies named identically both get id "v-demo-<suffix>"; find_vacancy returns the first while list.map-based mutations (archive/restore/close/status) match and mutate BOTH rows, so archiving one archives both.
recommended_fix: Mix a per-store counter or existing-id check into the suffix (e.g. append "-2" when the id already exists) in demo_store.create_vacancy.
